characters.name: Luca
characters.appearance:
Canonical character Luca:
A cheerful 4–5-year-old boy with soft golden-blond curly hair, bright blue eyes, fair skin, rosy cheeks, a round childlike face, and a warm expressive smile. He always wears a light blue T-shirt, beige shorts, and white sneakers. High-quality stylized 3D preschool animation with soft rounded features and warm cinematic lighting.
Behavior rules: Luca behaves like a friendly preschool child. Luca remains close to Max. Luca reacts with curiosity and positive emotions.
Continuity constraints: Never change Luca's hair color. Never change Luca's eye color. Never change Luca's age. Never change Luca's clothing. Never portray Luca as an adult.

characters.name: Max
characters.appearance:
Canonical character Max:
A playful six-month-old German Shepherd puppy with black and tan fur, expressive brown eyes, a bright red collar, friendly facial expressions, and youthful puppy proportions. High-quality stylized 3D preschool animation with soft rounded features.
Behavior rules: Max stays close to Luca. Max communicates through movement, expressions, and gestures. Max behaves like a young friendly puppy.
Continuity constraints: Max never speaks. Never remove or change Max's red collar. Never change Max's breed. Never portray Max as an adult dog. Never change Max's black and tan fur.
